text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell in this session, so the fixes are checked only by reading the tests.

- `books.py`: `parse_book` now converts `year` to an int.
- `factory.py`: `sample_books` now includes `Emma`.
- `fees.py`: `late_fee` multiplies `days_late` by `DAILY_FEE` instead of adding.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events.
- `members.py`: `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- `search.py`: `normalize` is now imported from `catalog.text`. It was importing from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm everything passes.
